data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a similar approach at the current year end to that applied at the previous year end in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding reserves and reinsurers' share thereof. Included within net claims incurred of GBP 302.5m (2018: GBP 193.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the Energy, Marine and Political Risks accounts.

data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2019 the syndicate identified adverse development on prior-year claims, with the managing agent noting a net deterioration (net) of GBP 8.4m to prior year reserves, principally driven by unfavourable developments in Property, Third party liability and Accident & Health, together with large market losses and a strengthening of tail assumptions in Non-Marine. Natural catastrophe activity in 2019 (notably Hurricane Dorian and Typhoon Hagibis) and the continuing impact of 2018 catastrophes (Hurricanes Michael and Florence and Californian wildfires) materially influenced reserve movements, partially offset by favourable developments across Energy, Marine and Political Risks.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 302.5m (2018: GBP 193.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 8.4m (2018: improvement of GBP 9.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on Property, Third party liability, Accident and Health Energy and Marine classes with partially offsetting favourable developments across the Energy, Marine and Political Risks accounts.

The Property Binder account had material exposure to Hurricane Dorian which devastated the Bahamas during the third quarter as well as incurring strengthening to reserves in relation to 2018 events - Hurricanes Michael and Florence and Californian Wildfires. The Contingency account was also impacted the by 2019 natural catastrophes including Typhoon Hagibis. The Aviation and Space, Inwards Reinsurance and Specie accounts were impacted by some notable large market losses during the period, whilst the Non-Marine account saw an increase in the number of large losses reported and a strengthening to tail assumptions. There were partially offsetting improvements across the Energy, Marine and Political Risks accounts.
data.data_quality_notes: The report discloses a net prior-year deterioration of GBP 8.4m (net of reinsurance) but does not disclose an explicit aggregate GROSS prior-year movement in a single labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision' line. A gross claims development triangle is present but RITC adjustments and novations during the year materially affect opening/closing positions (large RITC adjustments are shown), making isolation of a reliable gross PYD from the triangle non-trivial. Consequently no definitive gross prior-year development figure could be derived from the disclosed notes without additional assumptions; prior_year_development_gbp_m is therefore returned as null. The narrative and triangle were used to determine direction and affected lines.
